Bug_Title: Eq: equals() method defined that doesn’t override Object.equals(Object) (EQ_OTHER_USE_OBJECT)
Bug_Details:
This class defines an equals()
method, that doesn't override the normal equals(Object) method
defined in the base java.lang.Object class. 
The class should probably define a boolean equals(Object) method.
 equals() equals(Object) java.lang.Object boolean equals(Object)
Bug_Explanation: The equals() method defined in the Eq class does not override the equals(Object) method in the java.lang.Object class. As a result, the bug is present in the code.
Trigger_Explanation: The first test case triggers the bug by calling the `equals` method with an object of the same type, but with different values. The bug is triggered because the `equals` method does not override the `equals` method in the base `java.lang.Object` class, resulting in a false positive for equality.
